basic_info.name: جامعة العلوم الإسلامية العالمية
basic_info.nameEn: World Islamic Sciences and Education University
basic_info.affiliation: Al al-Bayt Royal Institute for Islamic Thought
basic_info.establishment_law: Special Law No. 16/2008, Official Gazette No. 4900, April 16, 2008

admission_requirements.general_requirements: Tawjihi (General Secondary Education Certificate) or equivalent; unified admission through Ministry of Higher Education for competitive programs; direct admission (parallel) also available
admission_requirements.min_tawjihi_mark_note: 50% is the absolute minimum for diploma programs; bachelor programs require 75-88% depending on major

colleges: Faculty of Sheikh Noah El-Qudha for Sharia and Law
Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Educational Science
Faculty of Traditional Islamic Art and Architecture
Higher Institute for Quranic Studies and Recitation
notable_programs: BA in Hanafi Fiqh (English language, first of its kind accredited by MOHE)
PhD in Faith and Islamic Philosophy
PhD in Quranic Sciences and Interpretation
PhD in Hadeeth and Its Sciences
MSc and PhD in Islamic Banking

tuition_fees.fee_structure_source: HPMI Yordania (2024 data, may be outdated)
tuition_fees.distance_learning_ba_fees: ~$350 USD per semester ($45/course + $100 registration + $100 one-time admission + $30 reenrollment)
tuition_fees.notes: Fee structure varies by program; data sourced from third-party sites and may not reflect current fees. Check official website for latest.

ranking_accreditation.accreditation: MOHE (Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research), FUIW (Federation of the Universities of the Islamic World), AArU (Association of Arab Universities)
ranking_accreditation.international_recognition: QS Arab Region Rankings 2026: #201-250; THE Impact Rankings 2024: 1501+

campus_locations: District Tariq (Tariq Hayy), Amman - Faculty of Dawa and Usuluddien, Faculty of Sharia and Law, Faculty of Arabic Language and Literature
Umm Udzainah District (Duwar Sadis), Amman - Faculty of Arts and Islamic Architecture
campus_facilities.scholarship_details: Scholarships available for high-achieving Tawjihi certificate holders (above 80% scores), prioritized for Jordanian nationals
centers: Arabic Language Center for Speakers of Other Languages
Consultation, Training, Planning and Development Center
The Center for the Rehabilitation of Imams and Preachers
